findings.title: Preserve case-insensitive matching for the children field
findings.message: The explicit child extraction is case-sensitive, unlike encoding/json's struct-field matching used previously. Previously accepted input containing "children" instead of "Children" now fails the numChildren validation. Without numChildren, the lowercase member remains in members and is decoded into the interface slice instead of through the explicit child-loading path.
findings.suggestion: Resolve Children using encoding/json-compatible case-insensitive matching, preferring an exact match, and remove all matching child-field spellings before decoding the remaining members. Add a regression test using lowercase "children" with a nonzero numChildren.
